agent_assumptions: Interior door heights assumed 2.1m, no elevation evidence for interior doors.
Exterior window family (sill1.0m/head2.8m AFL) applied uniformly across floors/facades based on consistent North/South/West elevation breakdowns; East assumed same family by visual similarity.
Wall representative plane: exterior footprint uses outer wall faces; interior partitions/corridor walls use observed centerlines snapped to footprint at boundary contact.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
